articles.title: What Is Graphene?
articles.description: Graphene is a one-atom-thick sheet of carbon that's stronger than steel, more conductive than copper and incredibly flexible. It has a wide range of applications — from medical sensors to water filtration — but large-scale production, material consistency, and integration challenges are slowing widespread adoption.
